int.title: Integrations
int.hint: Connect a GitHub repository, or import issues from Jira or Linear. Imported issues become this project's MG issues and are updated on every sync.
int.disconnectBody: Imported issues stay in Mahaam. For GitHub, uninstall the App on GitHub to revoke its access.
int.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored credential
int.github.desc: Two-way issues, pull requests, commits, workflow runs and deploys through the Mahaam GitHub App.
int.github.noRepos: The installation cannot see any repository yet — grant it one on GitHub.
int.github.connected: GitHub App installed — now pick a repository.
int.jira.desc: Import issues from a Jira Cloud project (every 30 minutes, or on demand).
int.linear.desc: Import issues from a Linear team (every 30 minutes, or on demand).
gh.notLinked: No GitHub repository is linked to this project yet.
gh.deployHint: Runs the workflow's workflow_dispatch trigger on the ref you choose.
